objects.name: Analytic 1928
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies inbound connections to Industrial Control System (ICS) Windows application servers from internet-routed Internet Protocol (IP) addresses. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the asset's documented role does not permit the connection and the destination/proxy/service is outside the approved communications profile, with process/service identity used as corroboration where available. Suppress approved vendor support, update repositories, remote operations, failover paths, and documented temporary connectivity.
